_comment: Smart Web Search provider config (opt-in). Delete this file or set enabled:false to use only L1 (wigolo, free). Copy to smart-web-search-mcp.config.json (no .example) and edit. NEVER commit the real file with keys.

tinyfish.notes: Set enabled:true to opt in. Then either set 'key' here OR have TINYFISH_API_KEY env / ~/.cursor/mcp.json entry.

tavily.notes: Set enabled:true + paste your tvly-... key here. Or set TAVILY_API_KEY env. Get free key at app.tavily.com (1000 credits/month free).

keenable.notes: Public tier (no key) is always available — 100K requests/month free with key. Set enabled:true + paste your keen_... key here, or set KEENABLE_API_KEY env. Get key at app.keenable.ai/console. Without key: 1K req/hour shared public tier, auto-throttles on 429.

serper.notes: L3 fallback (Google via serper.dev). Set enabled:true + paste your key here, or set SERPER_API_KEY env. Register at serper.dev for a one-time 2500 free queries, then pay-as-you-go. True key lives only in the deployed config.json, never here.
